ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel values with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels providing localized high contrast across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Stochastic white mottling and punctate spots clustered primarily at outer lobe regions and along the trailing edge; central fluke body contains high density of solid dark pixels with isolated linear high-intensity streaks in the lower quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped notch with an approximate vertex angle of 50 degrees; depth occupies approximately 10-12% of the total vertical bounding box height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular high-frequency serrations across the entire continuous trailing edge; peak-to-valley amplitudes range from 2-8 pixels relative to the mean edge boundary trajectory.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric concave curves extending from the median notch vertex to the distal tips of the lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel groups detected on the upper distal surfaces of both lobes, particularly concentrated towards the tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple non-parallel, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) detected in the lower-left, lower-right, and central-lower regions of the fluke body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, dark, textured clusters consistent with epibiotic colonization localized at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes; significant surface scarring present across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible vertical pixel streaks indicative of water shedding from the trailing edges of both lobes; visible water splashing/agitation at the base of the fluke.
